cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. That innocent cup started the argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tipped it onto my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. A badly positioned cup creates difficult choices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which shows how far the cup had already entered the situation.

mechanism: A uses control over the explanation to keep an early harmless object responsible as B progressively supplies A own causal actions.
confusable: Distinguish random blame shifting from returning to the same ribbon or cup for each revealed consequence while excluding A responsibility.
comparison: Tent failure shifts agency onto decoration; damaged letter shifts agency onto an ordinary cup despite A holding it.
seedUse: Canonical ribbon and cup seeds supply the stable callback; S01 should govern the conclusion or remedy instead of merely prefixing an evasive story.
